sources.title: Quantitative Perspectives on Cross-Asset Risk Premia
sources.note: The file uploaded in October 2026 is a June 2020 report, not a current outlook. It discusses cross-asset risk premia and model views; no current ETF return spreads are inferred.

sources.title: Global Asset Allocation Views 4Q 2026
sources.verification: Direct publisher HTML fetched; title and Published 01-10-2026 verified. Web cached body returned an older vintage, which was not used.
sources.source_summary: JPM favors US and Japanese equities, is neutral on Europe and emerging markets, prefers US high-yield carry and European duration. Its S&P 500 price target is 8,600 over 12 months.
sources.mapping_decision: No active eight-ETF BL view. SPY is a benchmark, not an allocation asset; US style/sector ETFs are not exact S&P 500 substitutes. No relative annual ETF return differences or numerical confidences are supplied. The index target is not a total-return forecast.
sources.earliest_use_policy: Only at a monthly rebalance whose preceding observed close falls strictly after 2026-10-01; the October 1 rebalance is ineligible. No eligible rebalance occurs in the sample ending October 8.

activation_requirements: Compatible ETF exposures or explicitly declared proxy assumptions
Annual relative-return difference in decimal units
Model uncertainty/confidence declared separately from provider claims
Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD; same-day returns excluded
Explicit validity horizon or review policy before activating a time-limited forecast
policy: Sources are research evidence, not executable signals. Do not infer return spreads from qualitative overweight/underweight language. Active numerical inputs remain in notebook configuration. A Drive upload date never substitutes for publication date.
